svg.title: Phase 2 milestone chain grouped by leg
svg.desc: Phase 2 splits into three legs. Origin leg: pickup, consolidate, drayage, export customs gate. Main haul by carrier: handover and in-transit tracking. Destination leg: import customs gate, inland haulage, delivered with proof of delivery, closed out. Customs steps are gates shown in amber, completion in green.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during consolidation at the warehouse?')
sendPrompt('What is drayage to the port?')
sendPrompt('Why is export customs a gate?')
sendPrompt('What happens at handover to the main carrier?')
sendPrompt('How is en-route tracking handled on the main haul?')
sendPrompt('Why is import customs a gate?')
sendPrompt('What is inland haulage to the receiver?')
sendPrompt('How is proof of delivery captured at the receiver?')
sendPrompt('What does close-out and reconciliation involve?')
